description: This file defines macros, structures, and function prototypes for configuring and controlling I/O pins on Atmel SAM0 microcontrollers, including pin multiplexing, attributes, and port configuration.

methods.name: soc_port_pinmux_set
methods.description: Configures the multiplexing of a specific port pin to a peripheral function.

methods.name: soc_port_configure
methods.description: Configures a single port pin with specified attributes and settings.

methods.name: soc_port_list_configure
methods.description: Configures multiple port pins in a batch with specified configurations.
